title: CMLTRPCNN — physics-constrained neural network for ABO3 microwave-dielectric permittivity prediction (companion code release)
description: Custom Python code, trained 5-seed ensemble checkpoint, and supporting scripts for the manuscript 'Physics-constrained decomposition identifies an A-site chemistry hierarchy associated with model-attributed soft-mode amplification in ABO3 microwave permittivity'. The manuscript is in preparation / under peer review; journal information and full citation details will be added to this repository upon acceptance. Includes the PCNN architecture , training pipeline, conformal calibration, applicability-domain analysis, virtual screening, physics-constrained genetic-algorithm inverse design, and per-figure reproduction scripts. Released under the MIT license.
